clubPatience.subject: liftCam_246~About Cage {%storyNumber}
clubPatience.text:
liftCam_247~Dear member,

Some members have reported that Cage {%storyNumber} "contains no relevant information".

We remind you that every cage is selected with great care. Observation requires patience.

Keep watching.

Primate Observation Club

clubRemoved.subject: liftCam_249~Cage {%storyNumber}: end of broadcast
clubRemoved.text:
liftCam_250~Dear member,

Due to technical problems at the location, Cage {%storyNumber} is no longer broadcasting.

No refunds will be issued.

Primate Observation Club

newsContract.title: liftCam_239~CITY RENEWS ELEVATOR CONTRACT
newsContract.subtitle: liftCam_240~UpRight Lifts will keep maintaining 40 public housing elevators. "Our record is spotless," says the company.

newsShutdown.title: liftCam_241~40 ELEVATORS SEALED OVERNIGHT
newsShutdown.subtitle: liftCam_242~Two residents of Larkspur Court were trapped for three hours. Inspectors found UpRight Lifts had signed yearly checks without visiting since 2019.

newsStairs.title: liftCam_243~LARKSPUR COURT TAKES THE STAIRS
newsStairs.subtitle: liftCam_244~The elevator will stay closed "for months". A tenant, 78, carries her dog up nine floors twice a day: "She refuses to walk past the doors."

start._comment: Initial state: empty car at night.

script.text: liftCam_2~Ground floor, Duchess. Again. Always the ground floor.
liftCam_3~Don't sniff the corner. We don't know who has been in that corner.
liftCam_4~Listen to it. It's humming again. A building should not hum.
liftCam_6~In my day elevators had a man in a hat. He hummed. That was allowed.
liftCam_9~Yes. Yes. No, I'm listening, Gary. I'm in the elevator.
liftCam_10~If I cut out, it's the elevator. Not me. I would never hang up on you.
liftCam_12~Unbelievable. Eleven floors and not one bar.
liftCam_17~Eleven B. Eleven B. Who lives in Eleven B and orders a box this heavy?
liftCam_18~Ninth floor? I didn't press nine.
liftCam_20~Hello? ...Nobody. The building is pranking me.
liftCam_22~Okay, box. This is it. Be brave.
liftCam_27~Wrong floor. Obviously. I wasn't doing anything.

d1_night._comment: The elevator rides on its own. Never explained.

script.text: liftCam_45~You were up all night again. I heard you. Up, down, up, down.
liftCam_47~And that noise. That's new. Don't make new noises at your age.
liftCam_48~There. Shiny. Nobody will notice, but I will.
liftCam_50~Ground floor, Toby. Just the G. Only the G.
liftCam_51~*beep beep beep beep beep beep beep beep*
liftCam_69~Boxes get confused. Let me just look inside.
liftCam_72~Duchess says it smells like my box.
liftCam_74~Your floor, ma'am. Have a nice day. Far away from this box.
liftCam_77~No, Gary, YOU listen. I made that spreadsheet. With my hands.
liftCam_78~Twelve years. Twelve years and they give the window desk to Kevin.
liftCam_81~Hi. Hello. Sorry. Just a normal man on a normal call.

d2_grey._comment: The man in the grey coat. The display says 13. The building has twelve floors. Never explained.

script.text: liftCam_89~Duchess, it is a perfectly good elevator.
liftCam_91~She has never done this. Eleven years and she has never done this.
liftCam_92~There. Carried like a queen. Happy?
liftCam_108~Four A. "Wardrobe, part two of two." Who sends a wardrobe in two parts?
liftCam_109~...It says "step fourteen" on the side. In marker.
liftCam_111~I'm leaving it at the door. I don't want to be part of step fourteen.
liftCam_121~Kevin's spreadsheet crashed. Guess who fixed it.
liftCam_122~Did you feel that last week? She dropped. Half a floor.
liftCam_123~Elevators don't drop. They have brakes. And inspections.
liftCam_125~Companies get checked, Gus. There are rules.
liftCam_126~Sure. And Kevin gets the window desk.
liftCam_132~There are six screws left over, Dev.
liftCam_101~Step fourteen says "attach panel F to panel F".
liftCam_102~There is one panel F, Dev.
liftCam_134~It leans, Dev. The wardrobe leans.
liftCam_135~It's an old building. Everything here leans.
liftCam_141~...Well. It's a sticker. Stickers don't lie.
liftCam_146~No, I'm in the elevator. Yeah, the creepy one.
liftCam_147~There's a camera. I bet some old guy watches it all day.
liftCam_148~Hi, old guy. Get a hobby.
liftCam_149~Kidding. Nobody watches these. They're not even plugged in.
liftCam_153~Do you live here? I know everybody. I don't know you.
liftCam_154~Well. Some people were raised in barns.
liftCam_159~I'm Toby. I'm seven. I am NOT allowed in here alone.
liftCam_160~If you see my mom, I'm not here.
liftCam_163~I was saying hi to the TV.
liftCam_166~Top floor. Nobody presses twelve at lunchtime. Best restaurant in town.
liftCam_168~...Did we stop? We were already stopped.
liftCam_172~Okay. Thank you. Lunch is over.
liftCam_175~Okay. Full routine. From the top.
liftCam_181~You're the new ones. Four A.
liftCam_183~You were very loud on Wednesday. Something about a step.
liftCam_184~Step fourteen. We don't talk about step fourteen.
liftCam_185~Everyone in this building has a step fourteen, dear.
liftCam_189~Don't you start today, old girl.
liftCam_191~UpRight Lifts? Larkspur Court. The elevator's dropping. Again.
liftCam_192~Next month? She's been "next month" since 2019.
liftCam_194~Just get through today. Then we'll see.
liftCam_197~Gary. Big news. Kevin's leaving. The window desk is mine.
liftCam_198~Today, Gary. Today is my day.

d6_stuck._comment: Stuck between 7 and 8 for three hours. Rescue through pried doors. Valid video.

script.text: liftCam_209~Hold. They want us to hold. We ARE holding. Between floors.
liftCam_210~Sit down. My husband used to say: panic standing, you panic twice.
liftCam_211~Your husband sounds like a wise man.
liftCam_212~He was an elevator man. In a hat. He hummed.
liftCam_213~Can I tell you something? I don't have a window desk. I lied to Gary.
liftCam_215~Gary is my brother. He has a boat.
liftCam_216~And the hair? Is that for Gary too?
liftCam_217~...You can see it from up here?
liftCam_218~Dear, the camera can see it.
liftCam_220~...and that is why I never speak to the woman in six B.
liftCam_221~She took your parking space for eleven years?
liftCam_222~And I don't even have a car.
liftCam_226~And a camera. Don't forget the camera.

d6_tech._comment: The tech seals the car: OUT OF ORDER sign on the inside of the doors, lights off.

script.text: liftCam_229~The brake pads are from... I don't know. Before me. Before you.
liftCam_230~Logbook says we inspected it every year. Signed by us.
liftCam_231~Nobody's been in this shaft since 2019, boss.
liftCam_232~This one should not still be running. We're shutting it down.
liftCam_233~And boss? It's not the only one.

d7_dark._comment: Dark car. Nobody gets in. The ghost object is visible with night vision only.

script.text: liftCam_258~Eleven B. On foot. Okay, box. Be brave.
liftCam_259~Gary? I'm on the stairs. Yes, I have signal. Every bar.
